title: 开头只有地板和墙面
content:
开头只有地板和墙面

各类家具以可爱果冻的动态方式分别从四周跳入场景，最终安静的形成最后的画面

图片1 作为第5s的结束

5s-8s: 之后，环境变暗，落地等的灯光逐渐亮起

其中重要的是“果冻式”的动态跳入

en.content:
---
At the beginning, only the floor and walls are visible.

Various pieces of furniture dynamically jump into the scene from all sides in a cute, jelly-like manner, eventually settling quietly to form the final image.

Image 1 marks the end of the 5th second.

5s-8s: Afterwards, the environment darkens, and the lighting, such as floor lamps, gradually illuminates.

The key element is the "jelly-like" dynamic jump-in.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Image prompt:
Solid color background, Pixar-rendered style {Italian-style 3D furniture}, including elements like {sofa, vintage table lamp, art deco painting, and greenery}, furniture set from a frontal perspective with correct three-dimensional perspective https://t.co/sWmRTjSkCr

[Thread 2] Video Prompt
At the beginning, only the floor and walls are visible.

Various pieces of furniture dynamically jump into the scene from all sides in a cute, jelly-like manner, eventually settling quietly to form the final image.

Image 1 marks the end of the 5th second.

5s-8s: Afterwards, the environment darkens, and the lighting, such as floor lamps, gradually illuminates.

The key element is the "jelly-like" dynamic jump-in.

重要なのは「ゼリー式」の動的な跳び込みです
